create_timm_backbone_model: create a TimmBackbone model wrapping a timm model as a feature extractor backbone
build_timm_backbone_from_pretrained: build a TimmBackbone model loaded from a pretrained timm model checkpoint
freeze_timm_backbone_batch_norm: freeze BatchNorm2d layers in a TimmBackbone model for training stability
unfreeze_timm_backbone_batch_norm: unfreeze previously frozen BatchNorm2d layers in a TimmBackbone model
run_timm_backbone_forward_pass: run a forward pass on a TimmBackbone model to extract feature maps from pixel values
